windowsAuthenticode.rationale: AAML intentionally publishes unsigned Windows executables. Archive checksums, exact artifact validation, GitHub provenance attestations, SBOMs, and release metadata provide release provenance; Windows may display an Unknown publisher or SmartScreen warning.

linuxMemberSigning.rationale: Official archive attestations and checksums provide release provenance; individual Linux members are not signed.

sbom.scope: One SBOM per RID archive generated from locked NuGet dependencies, first-party projects, and pinned Steam native components
